name: SpatialClip: 3D Video Editor
summary:
**SpatialClip** turns your headset into an editing studio for 2D, 3D, 180° and 360° VR video, with the windows floating in your room.

Join the community on Discord for tips, news and feature requests: https://discord.gg/wDVr6SZgUw
